test_case.test_name: Parameterized authenticated AMD driver upgrade with separately gated AGFHC post-validation
test_case.purpose: Upgrade from the recorded current AMD driver to the approved newer version, prove the new stack is loaded on every expected GPU, and perform the prescribed AGFHC health pass only under separate load authorization.
required_package: Signed current/target AMD driver and ROCm artifacts, checksums, versions and compatibility matrix
Exact vendor upgrade command/options, repository/dependency policy and complete logging
Approved reboot window, OOB access and tested rollback to the recorded prior stack
Pinned AGFHC artifact/config/spec plus duration, thermal/power limits and separate load authorization
test_case.test_command: After artifact/compatibility/rollback approval, capture the current packages, loaded modules and BDF bindings; execute the complete vendor upgrade with full logs, perform only an approved reboot, and prove the target packages/modules bind all expected GPUs. If separately authorized, run exactly the approved AGFHC post-validation and retain its full result; do not use AGFHC success as proof of package transaction.
test_case.expected_result: The authenticated target version replaces the recorded prior version without unresolved transaction errors, loads and binds every expected GPU after the approved boot boundary, and the separately approved AGFHC pass meets its exact oracle without thermal/power/platform fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete upgrade provenance/transaction and loaded per-BDF post-state; if AGFHC is required, its separately authorized full oracle must also pass. Tail logs or AGFHC alone are insufficient.
safety_gate: Package/module/reboot changes require explicit approval and working OOB/rollback.
Verify OS/kernel/firmware compatibility and active GPU processes/services before change.
AGFHC sustained load requires a distinct approval with cooling, power and timeout/abort limits.
Abort on dependency removal outside scope, partial transaction, failed boot/module/BDF, thermal/power/XID fault or lost access; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Source Key/Variant ID and separate standalone AGFHC identity
Signed artifact/checksum, current-to-target matrix and exact approved command
Complete package transaction, reboot identity and loaded module versions
If authorized: AGFHC artifact/config/full log, thermal/power trace, result and cross-reference
test_case.recovery: On upgrade or health failure, preserve package/module/boot/BDF/AGFHC evidence, stop load, and use only the approved OOB rollback to the recorded prior stack. Revalidate every GPU and service; do not reinstall or rerun automatically.
